newsitem.title: USA: The top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: The top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.

text.p: Following are the top 10 movies at the box office for the Friday to Sunday period, according to studio estimates collected by Exhibitor Relations Co. Inc. Final data are due Monday. (Rank last week in parentheses).
4 (1) Beavis and Butt-head Do America .. $10.4 million

NOTE: "Michael" was produced by now-defunct Turner Pictures, and released by New Line Cinema, both units of Time Warner Inc.. "Jerry Maguire" is released by TriStar Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp.. "101 Dalmatians" and "The Preacher's Wife" are released by Walt Disney Co.. "Beavis and Butt-head Do America" and "The Evening Star" are released by Paramount Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc.. "Scream" is released by Miramax Films, a unit of Disney. "One Fine Day" is released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp.. "Mars Attacks!" and "My Fellow Americans" are released by Warner Bros., a unit of Time Warner.
